name: OpenVibe.Sites

exposure.note: serves the placeholder pages of domains whose service is not public yet

liveness.none: static files served by nginx; there is no process of its own

shutdown.none: static files served by nginx; there is no process of its own to stop

startupRecovery.none: static files; nothing is in flight

conditions: manual: ovhost rollback sites --to <sha> rebuilds that commit and installs its vhosts (nginx -t before the reload); there is no ready URL, so nothing is automatic
rollback.window: any time; each deploy builds from a commit

blockers.none: a static build with no database

notes: Static placeholder generator; not a runtime.
